playerParse.linePattern: ^ID: \d+ \| Online IDs: EOS: (?<accountId>[0-9a-f]{32})\s+steam:\s*(?<playerId>\d{17}) \| Name:\s*(?<name>.+?) \| Team ID:

sources.title: How to Ban Players on your Squad Server (Shockbyte)

notes: Valve Source RCON. The stock SquadGame/ServerConfig/Rcon.cfg (verified against LinuxGSM Game-Server-Configs) carries IP=0.0.0.0, Port=21114, Password=, MaxConnections=5, ConnectionTimeout, SecondsBeforeTimeoutCheck and AuthenticationTimeout, with CLI overrides RCONIP=/RCONPORT=/RCONPASSWORD=/RCONMAXCONNECTIONS=. There is no separate enable flag - the file states 'Leaving this empty will keep RCON turned off', so passwordSetting doubles as enableSetting. Command provenance, checked file by file: AdminKick/AdminBan/AdminBroadcast/ListPlayers are on the official wiki (unquoted: 'AdminKick <NameOrSteamId> <KickReason>', 'AdminBan <NameOrSteamId> <BanLength> <BanReason>'); the quoted forms recorded here are verbatim from squad-rcon-php's README ('AdminKick "<NameOrSteamId>" <KickReason>', 'AdminBan "<NameOrSteamId>" "<BanLength>" <BanReason>') and from SquadTS use-rcon-squad-execute.ts (AdminKick "${anyID}" ${reason}, AdminBan "${anyID}" "${banLength}" ${message}). Note SquadJS's rcon.js contains neither AdminKick nor ShowServerInfo and leaves banLength unquoted ('AdminBan "${anyID}" ${banLength} ${message}'); ShowServerInfo is executed in SquadJS squad-server/index.js and in SquadTS showServerInfo(), and does NOT appear on the official wiki - two code sources only. Quoting of the ban length is cosmetic and accepted by the server either way. Ban length: 0 = permanent, 1m/1d/1M. ListPlayers output confirmed against a real fixture in SquadTS's test suite ('----- Active Players -----' header, then 'ID: 3 | Online IDs: EOS: <32 hex> steam: <steamid64> | Name: [FR] ComboAz | Team ID: 1 | Squad ID: N/A | Is Leader: False | Role: ...'); the linePattern was executed against that fixture and matches both active rows, captures name and Steam ID, and excludes the '----- Recently Disconnected Players [Max of 15] -----' rows, which carry 'Since Disconnect:' instead of 'Team ID:'. Kick and ban accept a player name, a Steam ID or an EOS ID (wiki writes <NameOrSteamId>; SquadJS and SquadTS call the argument anyID); Steam ID is recorded because Bans.cfg is keyed by SteamID64. AdminKickById/AdminBanById take the volatile per-match ID and are not used. CORRECTED: Bans.cfg lines are not always bare - the wiki's own example is 'John [SteamID 76561198000000000] Banned:76561198000000001:0 //Permanent ban for cheating', where the FIRST 17-digit number is the banning admin, not the banned player; the previous anchored pattern '^\s*(\d{17})\s*:' failed to match that form entirely, and a naive unanchored 17-digit match would capture the admin. lineIdPattern now keys on the id immediately followed by the expiry timestamp (0 = permanent), which resolves both that form and the bare '<steamid64>:<timestamp> // comment' form Shockbyte documents. There is no live unban command - unbanning means editing Bans.cfg. No MOTD command; scheduled messages live in ServerMessages.cfg.
